message: 天使の笑顔

name: Synn
message: 「These are the transfer exam questions from the past few years」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Ah, thank you very much」

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, Ryuusei Academy actually has a special talent admissions track, you know」

name: Amyrina
message: 「However, wouldn't relying on that alone cause me to fall behind in regular classes?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's true...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I believe it would be better in the long run to enroll after properly mastering my studies as well」
I wish I could make Nanaka boil the dirt from under her fingernails and drink it.

name: Amyrina
message: 「Besides, if I'm being taught by you, Mr. President, the top honor student in the academy... I'm sure I'll be fine!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a lot of pressure...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Where's Lolotte?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「When I mentioned we were going to study, she hurried off somewhere」

name: Synn
message: 「She ran away, huh...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I think studying can be enjoyable if you apply yourself properly, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, everyone has their strengths and weaknesses... How far have you studied, Amyrina?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Um... Only to the extent of reading through Lolotte's textbooks」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Alright, let's start with the basics for now」

name: Synn
message: 「Good work today. Here's some tea」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Thank you very much~」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Phew...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lately, I've been spending a lot more time with you, Mr. President」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... sorry. Did it bother you after all... not having Lolotte around with us?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「No, not at all! That's not what I meant... It's just...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I've come to want to spend time with you myself, Mr. President...」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see... Ahaha, that makes me happy」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It makes you... happy?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course it does. Especially when a cute girl like you says something like that, Amyrina」

name: Amyrina
message: 「M-My face is burning up\s01 I have to cool down fast... *gulp, gulp*」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It's even hotter!」

name: Synn
message: 「Calm down, Amyrina!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Phew... phew...」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry. I didn't think you'd be that surprised」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It's not your fault, President... It's my fault... because I always get embarrassed so easily」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I've lived so passively all this time... That's why I ended up fighting with Lolotte too」

name: Amyrina
message: 「If I had been able to act like this from the start, maybe I could have made up with Lolotte much sooner...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「And maybe I could have spent an enjoyable school life together with you, President」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, right now, Amyrina, you're carving out your own future with your own strength, aren't you?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「My own strength...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Ever since you discovered singing, all the way up to now...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「That's not true! The one who has always been pushing me forward is none other than...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「You, President, who has always supported me」

name: Amyrina
message: 「On my own, I surely never would have known about singing, or the joy of singing songs」

name: Amyrina
message: 「You taught me that. Thank you so very much」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No. It wasn't me, it was Sacchin... you know」

name: Amyrina
message: 「But you're the one who taught me how wonderful singing is, President」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Wonderful... Come on, it wasn't anything that grand\s03 Besides, Misa's the one who invited you to the choir」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Heehee... Even you're getting embarrassed, President」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Still, you're the one who pulled the trigger of my destiny, President. There's no mistaking that」

name: Synn
message: 「Amyrina...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「If I were ever to write a guidebook about myself, I would list your name first, President」

name: Synn
message: 「No thanks, please don't\s02」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I... thought about this at the last service, when I realized there were so many people willing to listen closely to my voice」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I want to study singing more and more, and become able to sing even more wonderful songs...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I thought, I want so many people to hear them」

name: Amyrina
message: 「To do that, I have to learn more and more about this world... not just about singing, but about everything」
So that's why she felt motivated to tackle studying for her exams, too.

name: Synn
message: 「If it's you, Amyrina, I know you can do it」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Really!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I'll help you out too, so you can make your dream come true, Amyrina」

name: Amyrina
message: 「My dream...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Let's make it come true, together」
